2608.03606.title: Learning Clinical-Trial Strategy: Offline Policy Training for Decision Agents
2608.03606.paper_summary: Clinical development is sequential decision-making under uncertainty, where a sponsor must plan a portfolio of experiments from heterogeneous evidence. We study this setting by framing oncology clinical development as an offline decision-making problem in which an agent predicts the next six-month trial portfolio of an oncology drug program from information available at the decision date. To support this, we construct a temporal dataset that combines 31.7k heterogeneous public data records, including trial registries, regulatory reviews, sponsor filings, utilization data, and epidemiology, into 881 offline decision episodes across 45 historical programs. We compare four offline objectives: behavioral cloning, reward-weighted behavioral cloning, learned-reward training, and value-based implicit Q-learning against four frontier LLM agents that share a common date-gated retrieval scaffold across held-out drug, sponsor, drug-class, and temporal splits. Models trained offline outperform the non-fine-tuned baselines, particularly in the post-August 2025 contamination-clean holdout. Reward-weighted behavioral cloning performs the best, obtaining 46.2% indication F1 and 14.2% strict F1 against 25.0% and 2.1%, respectively, for the best-performing tool agent on each metric. These results suggest that structured offline learning can teach agents to plan clinical experiments.
2608.03606.paper_summary_zh: 臨床開發是在不確定性下的連續決策過程，贊助者必須從異質證據中規劃一組實驗。我們通過將腫瘤學臨床開發框架化為一個離線決策問題來研究這一情境，在這個問題中，代理人根據決策日期可用的信息預測腫瘤藥物計劃的下一個六個月的試驗組合。為了支持這一點，我們構建了一個時間數據集，將31.7k個異質公共數據記錄結合起來，包括試驗登記、監管審查、贊助者檔案、使用數據和流行病學，形成45個歷史計劃中的881個離線決策情節。我們比較了四個離線目標：行為克隆、獎勵加權行為克隆、學習獎勵訓練和基於價值的隱式Q學習，對比四個前沿LLM代理，這些代理在持出藥物、贊助者、藥物類別和時間分割上共享一個共同的日期門控檢索框架。離線訓練的模型在表現上超越了未經微調的基準，特別是在2025年8月後的污染清理持出中。獎勵加權行為克隆表現最佳，獲得46.2%的指示F1和14.2%的嚴格F1，而每個指標上表現最佳的工具代理分別為25.0%和2.1%。這些結果表明，結構化的離線學習可以教會代理人規劃臨床實驗。
2608.03606.author: William Bolton et.al.
